reviews.selector: republishes report-bearing modules with exact evidence and recoverable old payloads
reviews.scope: Read exact delta, recursion/strict object boundary/staging-publication-rollback call chain and all five new selector groups/eight expanded cases. Reports classification depends only on first relative directory component, never prefix or nested occurrence. Entry reparse rejection precedes recursion/copy, all other JSON still requires object roots and deep merge. Exact path+raw-byte tree identities on repeats/backups/source, late-target collision and failed-stage evidence, four outside-boundary rejection cases, no-write DryRun and external junction target preservation provide meaningful producer controls.
